The '''Xim Thrones''' were nine [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that were&mdash;or in the case of one of them, were proclaimed to be&mdash;[[Politics/Legends|politically]] and ceremonially central to the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]. They were, in order, [[Argai]], [[Chandaar]], [[Cadinth]], [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]], [[Thanium]], [[Yutusk]], [[Wyndigal 2|Huronom]], [[OHS3842-03|Astigone]], and [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]]. The concept of the Xim Thrones evolved out of the [[Four Thrones of Cron]], a term used in the [[Kingdom of Cron|realm]] of Xim's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Xer VIII]].<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>
